dedupe_keys.name: leakg3pd t customer tank leakage benchmark

description: LeakG3PD-T extends the LeakG3PD simulated water-network collection with demand patterns for customers who have private storage tanks. Matheus Pilotto and collaborators select sixty percent of consumption nodes with base demand between one and three litres per second for these tanks. The documented pipe-parameter uncertainties are two percent for length and roughness and one percent for diameter. The repository provides generator code and a public Drive archive named EPANET Net 3-T.zip. Coverage is the synthetic Net3 network; the short README does not state the archive time interval or a common sampling frequency. The release is freely accessible, and its Drive page explicitly permits anyone with the link to access without sign-in. GitHub specifies EUPL 1.2 for the repository, while a separate data-archive licence is not stated. The archive was too large for browser preview and was not downloaded. Its demand assumptions therefore require checking before operational use. Simulation uses include testing pressure-demand relationships and leakage detection with customer storage. It relates to model-wntr and data-leakdb, with distinct inputs from the parent LeakG3PD draft.
